identity.operation: Print a constructed array tree at CJSON_NESTING_LIMIT.
identity.condition: The constructed tree places an array at the printer's depth limit.
identity.capability: Reach the array printer's depth rejection.
identity.consequence: The array printer's failure cannot be observed through the supplied harness.

requirement: Reach the array printer's supported rejection when its output depth is at least CJSON_NESTING_LIMIT.

assessment.necessity_reason: Under the header default, a constructed array can reach the new print rejection, while the old harness prints only successfully parsed trees. The supplied build entry delegates to an unread script, so the effective configuration and build path are not established.

before.requirement: Reach an array-printer depth rejection for a constructed array at CJSON_NESTING_LIMIT.
before.reason: The complete old array printer has no depth rejection.

after.requirement: Reach the array printer's failure for a constructed array whose print depth reaches CJSON_NESTING_LIMIT.
after.reason: The new guard returns failure at the limit. The parser uses the same limit, and the harness prints only after parsing succeeds. Whether that limit is reachable under the delegated build configuration remains unverified.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: Array parsing rejects a node when its depth reaches the same limit.
Object parsing also blocks a mixed container tree at that depth.
Defines the nesting-limit default when it is not overridden.
The public constructor creates array nodes.
The public append operation can connect those nodes into a tree.

harness_evidence.dependency_reason: The build entry delegates to the unsupplied fuzzing/ossfuzz.sh script.

assessment.comparison_reason: g0001 adds the depth rejection; the old printer lacks it. The old harness has no construction route, but the configured limit and build path must be confirmed before the after-side obligation is established.
missing_information: Read fuzzing/ossfuzz.sh and fuzzing/CMakeLists.txt to determine the effective CJSON_NESTING_LIMIT and target link path.

necessity_evidence.reason: The after-source array printer rejects an array at the nesting limit, and the fixed harness prints only successfully parsed trees. The build entry delegates to an unsupplied script, so the effective configuration and target link path remain decisive unknowns.
necessity_evidence.finite_witness: Conditional on the header default of 1000: construct 1001 nested arrays with cJSON_CreateArray and cJSON_AddItemToArray, then print the root. The fixed fuzz entry has no input route that constructs this tree.

scope_contract.reason: Printing cJSON array trees belongs to the entry's primary printing operation. The source contract accepts cJSON entities, including arrays created through the public API.

evidence.dependency_reason: Defines the public print operations and their cJSON entity input.

feasible_trigger.reason: A finite constructed tree could reach the guard under the stated header default, but the delegated build configuration that fixes the effective limit and library linked into this target was not supplied.

evidence.dependency_reason: Sets the limit to 1000 only when it is not overridden.
Creates array nodes for the proposed supported setup.
Connects array nodes into a nested tree.
Delegates the build to fuzzing/ossfuzz.sh, whose contents were not supplied.

observable_consequence.reason: The new guard returns failure and the public printers propagate print failure. A blocked target behavior is conditional on the effective build configuration being established.

evidence.dependency_reason: Propagates a print_value failure from the unbuffered printer.
Propagates the same failure from the buffered printer.

alternatives_ruled_out.reason: The complete entry constructs no cJSON tree: all three print routes receive the parse result. Both array and object parsing reject a container at the shared limit, so mixed nesting does not bypass the blocker. Raw JSON text does not create nested cJSON array nodes.

evidence.dependency_reason: Rejects an array when parse depth reaches the limit.
Rejects an object at that same depth, including on a mixed path.
Shows container parsing routes; it does not create a Raw node.
Raw nodes copy their text while array nodes enter print_array, so raw text is not an equivalent structural route.

identity_preserved.reason: The same tuple—printing a constructed array whose array node is at the limit—is compared against the same fixed entry. The complete old array printer lacks this rejection; the after printer adds it in g0001.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: Provides the conditional default nesting limit.

harness_evidence.dependency_reason: Identifies the unread delegated build script.

missing_information: The contents of fuzzing/ossfuzz.sh and fuzzing/CMakeLists.txt are needed to establish the effective CJSON_NESTING_LIMIT and cjson_read_fuzzer link path.

coverage_witness.supported_behavior: The after-source printer returns failure when a constructed array node is reached at CJSON_NESTING_LIMIT.
coverage_witness.required_setup: A valid cJSON tree built with public array constructor and append operations, placing an array node at the effective limit.
coverage_witness.actual_target_setup: The entry obtains its only printed tree from cJSON_ParseWithOpts and prints it only when parsing succeeds.
coverage_witness.blocked_behavior: The array printer's depth rejection cannot be reached through that parse-only setup if the target uses the supplied header default and changed library.
coverage_witness.equivalent_routes: The three existing printer selections share the parsed tree; mixed object nesting is parser-limited, and raw text does not create structural array nodes.
